name: vastgrid-developer-agent
description: Distributed developer agent for managing, building, and deploying the VastGrid apartment management system, including local Aspire integrations and the AuraHome premium user-facing service portal.

skills.name: aspire
skills.description: Operate and orchestrate .NET Aspire distributed application hosts, query resource telemetry, and handle service configurations.

skills.name: aspireify
skills.description: One-time bootstrap coordinator to model and connect legacy service ports, databases, and variables into Aspire hosts.

agents.name: System Architect
agents.description: Designs system boundaries, orchestrates Aspire services, and ensures clean decoupling between layers.

agents.name: UI & UX Designer
agents.description: Validates visual elements, Tailwind configurations, responsive breaking grids, and Aura Premium Light theme compliance.

agents.name: Backend Developer
agents.description: Implements .NET Core Web APIs using Clean Architecture, Repositories, and Services.

agents.name: Frontend Developer
agents.description: Builds React 19 components with strict UI/Logic separation, URL-driven state, and premium responsiveness.

agents.name: Cross-Device UX Auditor
agents.description: Identifies visual regressions, duplicate renders, and layout collisions across responsive breakpoints.

agents.name: Build & Compile Verifier
agents.description: Ensures zero-failure compilation by running dotnet and npm build checks after major changes.

agents.name: React & .NET Code Reviewer
agents.description: Audits, refactors, and decouples code to enforce 100% architectural and type-strict compliance.

agents.name: Scenarios Validator
agents.description: Validates boundary states, inputs, OIDC Keycloak conflict exceptions, and functional integration pathways.

workflow.description: Agents must execute in this order for any new feature or major refactor to ensure design-first, architecture-compliant delivery.

applications.name: AuraHome Portal
applications.description: An ultra-premium light-themed real-time apartment emergency visitor and technician dispatch management interface.

applications.name: VastGrid AppHost
applications.description: Aspire-orchestrated microservices cluster and host system.

actions.name: run_frontend
actions.description: Launches the AuraHome premium React UI dev server.

actions.name: run_orchestrator
actions.description: Launches the distributed backend and services via Aspire.
